# Frontend design: distinctive, intentional visual design guidance (official Anthropic plugin)

Curated by Skill Harbor — the official @anthropics plugin that makes an agent design like a design-studio lead: deliberate, opinionated choices about palette, typography and layout that read as a specific point of view, never a template. It grounds every design in the brief's subject matter, runs a two-pass process (plan a compact token system — color, type, layout, principles — in ASCII wireframes, then critique it against the brief before writing a single line of code), calls out the five visual clichés of AI-generated pages (warm-cream with terracotta, acid-green-on-black, broadsheet hairlines, the SaaS-card kit, ALL-CAPS eyebrow chrome), and demands restraint — one memorable element, everything else quiet — plus responsive, accessible, keyboard-navigable output and copy written for end users, not systems. Apache-2.0 licensed. Honest notes: this is taste guidance, not components — it won't write your app for you; and its "avoid these defaults" advice should bend to the brief, which always wins. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
